era: Fandom 2019 (the wikia.com to fandom.com move finished in 2019; Arquivo.pt captures of marvel.fandom.com, starwars.fandom.com and harrypotter.fandom.com Jan-Oct 2019): the dark global navigation bar with the FANDOM wordmark, Games / Movies / TV / Video, Explore Wikis, a search field, Sign In and Register; the wiki's community header with its wordmark, page count and wiki menus; the article with categories, Edit and its dropdown, Share, table of contents and the right rail; Special:Search with This wiki / All wikis, Advanced options and results; the global footer with Explore, Follow Us, Overview (About, Careers, Press, Contact, Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, Global / Local Sitemap), Community (Community Central, Support, Help), Advertise (Media Kit) and The FANDOM App. The live site is behind Cloudflare, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector.
